tei:div.tei:p: A psalm, a song for the Sabbath day: It is good to thank the Lord and to sing praise to Thy Name, O Most High, to proclaim Thy kindness in the morning and Thy faithfulness at night, on the ten-stringed harp, through meditation on the zither. For Thou hast gladdened me, O Lord, with Thy deeds, in the works of Thy hands do I exult. How great are Thy works, O Lord, profound indeed are Thy thoughts. A simpleton cannot know, nor can a fool understand this, when the wicked flourish like grass and all evil-doers blossom forth only to be destroyed for ever. But Thou art supreme to eternity, O Lord. Behold Thine enemies, O Lord, behold Thine enemies shall perish, all evil-doers shall scatter. Then shalt Thou lift up my horn like the unicorn, I am anointed with fresh oil. Then shall my eye look down upon my adversaries, when evil men rise up against me my ears shall hear. The righteous shall flourish like the palm, like the cedar on Lebanon shall he grow. Those planted in the House of the Lord shall blossom forth in the courts of our God. They will yet be luxuriant in old age, full of sap and fresh will they be, so as to proclaim that the Lord is upright, my Rock in whom there is no wrong.
